spans.s: bhali, acc. to Tib. bu ma rta, messenger: MSV 〔iv.62.14〕. The Ap. word bhali in a vs, Hem. 〔4.353〕, could be interpreted in this sense (whose messenger is longing for things hard to get, they think naught of distance), but the comm. glosses abhyāsaḥ.

Bhallika (in Mv var. ˚iya; = Pali Bhallika, ˚iya, ˚uka), n. of a merchant, associated with Trapuṣa, often in dvandva cpd.: LV 〔381.4 ff.〕; Mv 〔iii.303.5 ff.〕 (˚iya, with v.l. ˚ika, 〔303.13〕; 〔305.6〕); Divy 〔393.19〕.
bhalluka, m. (= Skt. Lex. id.; Skt. bhallūka, Deśīn. bhallu), a bear: Mvy 〔4781〕.
